verses.text: Ephraim’s men gathered, crossed north, and confronted Jephthah: ‘Why’d you go fight Ammon without calling us? We’ll burn your house down with you inside!’ 🔥
Jephthah answered, ‘My people and I were in a serious fight with Ammon. I called you, but you didn’t rescue me from them. 🗣️
‘When I saw you weren’t coming, I risked my life and crossed over to fight Ammon. Yahweh handed them over to me. So why come up today to fight me?’ ⚔️
Jephthah gathered Gilead’s men and fought Ephraim. Gilead defeated them because Ephraim had mocked them as runaway Ephraimites living between Ephraim and Manasseh. ⚔️
Gilead’s men took control of the Jordan crossings. Whenever an Ephraimite fugitive asked to cross, they asked, ‘Are you from Ephraim?’ If he said, ‘No,’ 🛑
they told him, ‘Say “Shibboleth.”’ He said ‘Sibboleth’ because he couldn’t pronounce it right. Then they seized and killed him at the river crossings. Forty-two thousand Ephraimites fell then. ⚠️
Jephthah led Israel for six years. Then he died and was buried in one of Gilead’s towns. 🕊️
After him, Ibzan from Bethlehem led Israel. 🌿
He had thirty sons and sent his thirty daughters to marry outside his clan. He also brought in thirty women from outside the clan for his sons. He led Israel for seven years. 👨‍👩‍👧
Ibzan died and was buried in Bethlehem. 🕊️
After him, Elon from Zebulun led Israel for ten years. 🌿
Elon from Zebulun died and was buried at Aijalon, in Zebulun’s land. 🕊️
After him, Abdon son of Hillel, from Pirathon, led Israel. 🌿
He had forty sons and thirty grandsons, who rode seventy young donkeys. He led Israel for eight years. 🫏
Abdon son of Hillel died and was buried at Pirathon, in Ephraim’s hill country, the land of the Amalekites. 🕊️
